core_obligations: For an etale morphism varphi : U -> X form the fiber-product diagram with F_U and F_X and exhibit the dotted arrow U -> U \times_{varphi, X, F_X} X (proof lines 345-356). The dotted arrow is etale and a universal homeomorphism by Etale Morphisms, Lemma etale-lemma-relative-frobenius-etale, hence an isomorphism, functorially in U (proof lines 356-359). This verifies the hypothesis of Lemma lemma-baffling for g = F_X, so F_X induces the identity on H^j(X, Z/nZ) for all j >= 0 (bridge sentence at lines 340-343 plus the lemma's conclusion).
proof_roadmap: Set up the fiber-product diagram for an arbitrary etale morphism and identify the dotted comparison arrow (proof lines 345-356).
Conclude the dotted arrow is an isomorphism via the etale relative frobenius lemma, verifying the hypothesis of lemma-baffling (proof lines 356-359).
